title: RAM synchronous-read returns mem[addr+1] (off-by-one address)
source: VeriSight projects/ram. Ground truth from ram_rtl.sv:29 vs ram scoreboard expected values.

ground_truth.notes: ram_rtl.sv:29 reads `mem[addr+1]` instead of `mem[addr]`. Read of addr returns the value stored at addr+1, matching EXP=201 ACT=110 (110 was written to the next location).
